query:
SELECT e.full_name, a.date, a.shift_label, a.clock_in_time, a.clock_out_time, a.status
FROM attendance_records a
JOIN employees e ON e.id = a.employee_id
WHERE e.full_name LIKE '%張喆翔%'
  AND a.date >= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY a.date DESC, a.clock_in_time DESC
LIMIT 10;
